name: SlimeVR
blurb: SlimeVR is a set of open hardware sensors and open source software that facilitates full-body tracking (FBT) in virtual reality.
description:
SlimeVR is a set of open hardware sensors and open source software that facilitates full-body
tracking (FBT) in virtual reality. With no base station required, SlimeVR makes wireless
VR FBT affordable and comfortable.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
